python3 -c "
import parse

# Test findall with case_sensitive using literal text in format
result = list(parse.findall('Hello {:w}', 'Hello world hello foo', case_sensitive=True))
print('findall case_sensitive True:', [r.fixed for r in result])

# Without case_sensitive (default), it should match both
result2 = list(parse.findall('Hello {:w}', 'Hello world hello foo'))
print('findall case_sensitive False:', [r.fixed for r in result2])
"
